name: Nao
source:
Cheerful and lively, she’s kind and open-hearted toward everyone. She takes an interest in the protagonist as a city man and playfully approaches him.
Although provocative, she has no experience with men and gets flustered when called out.

[From [url=https://www.miel-soft.com/inakaharem.html]official site[/url]]
